_src: MEASURED from /opt/aieditor-work/reference/motion-2026-10-09/motion4.mp4 (1920x1080, 30 fps, 232 f, 7.72 s) on 2026-10-09: card plane tracked per frame (ECC homography on the composer footer, f60 = canonical), each homography fitted to a CSS 3D pose (perspective 1000 px, origin = card centre 957,555); curves fitted as cubic-bezier (max error given). Times in seconds; 'at' = offset from the beat it hangs off. Travel in card px at the resting scale (card = 1034 px wide).

camera.perspective_note: the per-frame fit error is flat for 450-1700 px (5.9-7.0 px max); 1000 chosen
camera.rest_note: settled pose f40-f60: s 0.997-1.003, rz 0.51-0.56 deg, ry 0.4-0.8 deg, rx noisy +-3 deg around 0 (footer-only track)

entrance.note: whip-in from a close, tilted view: send-button displacement decays 481 px (f3) -> 22 px (f13), ~0.74x per frame; start pose extrapolated (f1-f8 are motion-blurred, f1-f2 hold the previous shot)

push.note: push-in 1.0 -> 1.327 from f64 (t 2.10) to f112, peak f125; with no chips it starts at typing end - 0.17 s

pull.note: pull back 1.327 -> 0.989 from f126 (t 4.17) to f198

center_on_card.note: the camera keeps the growing card centred: ty += s * dH / 2 with the card-growth easing (measured +30 px at row 1, +56 row 2, +34 row 3 (s falling), +53 working)

exit.note: accelerating push-through: s 0.989 (f216) -> 1.352 (f226) -> ~3.0 at the cut (f232); zoom-blurred from f225

placeholder.note: per-character fade-out left->right (f15-f28), overlapping the first typed chars

typing.note: 110 chars in 1.55 s (f23-f69): 2.56 chars/frame steady, last ~8 chars slower; no chunking; chars appear at full opacity

caret.note: visible f24-f83, no blink; gone 0.47 s after the last char

send_icon.note: mic -> arrow once the prompt has text (neutral composer only)

flight.note: each file flies in from beside / below the card as an icon tile, large (x2.2-2.6, near the camera) and tilted, and lands in 8-9 frames (c0 f84->f92, c1 f100->f108, c2 f106->f114, c3 f118->f126, c4 f130->f138); chip beats = first visible frame
flight.ease_note: hand-fitted to the tile path (c3 holds big at the top f118-f122 then lands f126; c1 crosses fast): ease-in-out; not a least-squares fit (tiles are motion-blurred and occluded)

grow.note: the card grows one chip row at a time: +70 px (row 1, f105-f111), +95 (row 2, f127-f137), +97 (row 3, f148-f157); a row grows when its last chip lands, rows >= 0.72 s apart

expand.note: tile -> pill with the file name wiping in left->right: c0 f118, c1 f128, c2 f142, c3 f154, c4 f166 (12 frames apart), ~14 frames each

working.note: f179-f189: card +98 px; the typed prompt moves into a right-aligned bubble (30 -> 26 px type) with an avatar, then 'Working' + a dot spinner fade in

result.note: NEW (MO05) — not in the reference: reuses the measured entrance easing + tilt language; the camera pans up / pulls back to frame the app's real result panel above the composer
